subject: [PATCH v2 3/3] mm: vmscan: tell direct reclaim the allocation is ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the direct reclaim process in Linux to pass an ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT flag from the allocation down to try_to_free_pages(). This change allows the allocation to take free pages of any migratetype, rather than being restricted to unmovable and reclaimable pageblocks. The goal is to improve performance by reducing fragmentation during high-order direct reclaims. The patch is based on a previous fix for defrag_mode and has been tested with Dev Jain's 64K mTHP benchmark.

reviews.author: Vlastimil (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested passing the entire alloc_flags value to try_to_free_pages() instead of just ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT, and otherwise gave a positive review (LGTM)
reviews.raw_body:
I'd perhaps pass whole alloc_flags to try_to_free_pages(), but other than
that LGTM.

This allows the allocation to take free pages of any migratetype, rather than being limited to unmovable and reclaimable pageblocks. The change is intended to improve performance by reducing fragmentation during direct reclaim. The patch was tested on a 64K mTHP benchmark and showed improved results with defrag_mode enabled.
